GSEA enrichment plot

Source: R/gseaEnrichmentPlot.R
gseaEnrichmentPlot.Rd

The standard gene set enrichment analysis figure for one or more gene sets, on a shared axis of the ranked gene list: the running enrichment score (top), a tick for each gene of the set (middle), and the ranked statistic itself (bottom). The running score is that of fgsea::plotEnrichmentData() and clusterProfiler's gseaplot2(); the enrichment score is its largest deviation from zero, marked with a dashed line.

Usage

gseaEnrichmentPlot(
  x,
  pathways = NULL,
  gsea.param = 1,
  colors = NULL,
  show.ticks = TRUE,
  show.metric = TRUE,
  metric.color = "#7F7F7F",
  main = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An fgsea bundle - list(stats = <named numeric>, pathways = <named list>, results = <fgsea table, optional>) - or a clusterProfiler gseaResult.

pathways

Gene sets to plot, by name. Default: the three most significant (or the first three when there are no results).

gsea.param

Weight exponent of the running score (1 is standard GSEA).

colors

Named vector of colours for the gene sets. Unnamed sets fall back to the default palette.

show.ticks, show.metric

Logical; draw the hit ticks and the ranked statistic panels.

metric.color

Colour of the ranked statistic.

main

Optional plot title.

Value

A plotly object. The per-set summary (enrichment score, NES and adjusted p-value when results are given, set size, leading edge) is attached as attribute "table".

See also

gseaEnrichmentPlotServer(), fgsea::plotEnrichment()

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

data(example_gsea)
gseaEnrichmentPlot(example_gsea)
